sloka: अर्दयित्वा पुरीं लङ्कामभिवाद्य च मैथिलीम् ।समृद्धार्थो गमिष्यामि मिषतां सर्वरक्षसाम् ।। ५.४२.३६।।।।
transliteration: ardayitvā purīṁ laṅkāmabhivādya ca maithilīm ।samṛddhārtho gamiṣyāmi miṣatāṁ sarvarakṣasām ।। 5.42.36।।।।

translations.english: "I shall destroy the city of Lanka and pay my respects to Mythili right under the nose of all demons. I will return with my purpose accomplished.
